[Education]{.lado-titulo}

- M.Sc. in Mathematics, IME-USP, since 2025, expected to finish in February 2027.
- B.Sc. in Mathematics, IME-USP, 2020–2024.

I am a master's student in Mathematics at the Institute of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science of the University of São Paulo (IME-USP), advised by [Christina Brech](https://www.ime.usp.br/~brech/). I work in set-theoretic topology, especially on Boolean algebras, locally compact scattered spaces and cardinal sequences.

As an undergraduate, I studied Boolean algebras and Stone duality, under which superatomic Boolean algebras correspond to compact scattered spaces. In my master's, I moved on to locally compact scattered spaces and their cardinal sequences, constructing spaces with uncountable cardinal sequences.
